components.Navbar: Sticky header with Crystal Glass. Logo left, Nav center, Login + Demo right. Ensure text visibility over content.
components.Hero: Asymmetrical 12-col grid. Text col-span-7 with massive H1. Image col-span-5 with glassmorphism overlay containing 'DPDPA Compliant' badge. Primary CTA is solid sapphire, Secondary is ghost.
components.PainPoints: Side-by-side Technical Grid or split section. Left side: muted red/gray for 'The Old Way' (Chaos/WhatsApp/Files). Right side: crisp Sapphire blue for 'The Audinexa Way'.
components.Features: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A). 9 features mapped to asymmetrical spans (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for core feature, col-span-4 for smaller features). Generous inner padding (p-8).
components.HowItWorks: 4-step horizontal timeline or vertical tracking line. Active steps highlight in Sapphire blue. Minimalist iconography.
components.Pricing: 3 pricing tiers fetched via API. Middle card (STANDARD) emphasized with 'Tracing Beam' effect or darker background (bg-slate-900 text-white) to pop out.
components.SecurityShowcase: Swiss Brutalist minimalist section. High contrast, data-heavy look (monochrome with blue accents) for DPDPA, 2FA, Audit Logs.
components.Testimonials: Text-heavy block. Use a complementary Serif font (like Cormorant Garamond or similar if possible, or stick to italics Manrope) to contrast with the UI and build deep human trust.
components.FAQ: Minimalist accordion list. Bottom border only on items, no surrounding boxes. Large clear typography.
components.FinalCTA: Massive typography (text-6xl) centered on a rich Sapphire background or using the abstract blue wave background. High contrast white text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Typography: Import 'Cabinet Grotesk' (or similar geometric sans like 'Clash Display' / 'Outfit') for headings and 'Manrope' for body in global CSS.
2. Iconography: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (if already installed) for crisp B2B styling.
3. Refactoring: Refactor ALL components in '/app/frontend/src/modules/landing/v2/components/' using this exact JSON guide.
4. Spacing: DO NOT use default cramped Tailwind padding. Apply `py-24` or `py-32` for sections.
5. Testing: MUST apply `data-testid` to every interactive element, button, and section wrapper.
6. Functionality: Retain API calls (`/api/landing/pricing` and demo booking). Connect the visual redesign to existing state logic.
